shape.account_id: the Zalo number of the turn

customer.note: the three-step switch on a row (Q126-16 b): view = meta + content + vector + kg on that row; download = view + file.get

delivered_to.note: principals a product row was delivered to (BS-7): each may file.get it; revoke = remove the ref (signed links expire in 15 min)

overrides: sensitive kinds (flags.sensitive ∈ finance · health · child · personal) ⇒ customer always denied, whatever the switch (R-JN-11)
state (verified) is never granted to a non-person principal; verified needs flags.verified.by (R-JN-14)
the customer switch is set by a PERSON on the web (REST PATCH), never by MCP; a sensitive row refuses it (audience_locked)

access_denied.note: reads answer 404 so a row's existence never leaks

audience_locked.note: PATCH customer on a sensitive row
